title: Grok Plugin Marketplace Index
description: Repo-level marketplace index. Config files: `.grok-plugin/marketplace.json` (preferred), `.grok-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (checked in that order; first existing file wins). Deserialized into `MarketplaceIndex`. Forward-compatible: unknown top-level keys (e.g. `$schema`, `metadata`) are ignored by serde.

name.description: Marketplace display name. Required, non-optional field on `MarketplaceIndex`.

plugins.description: Indexed plugin entries. `#[serde(default)] Vec<IndexEntry>` — absent key deserializes to an empty vec.

name.description: Owner display name. Required field on `IndexOwner`.

indexEntry.description: A single plugin entry in the marketplace index.

version.description: Version string from index metadata. `#[serde(default)] Option<String>`.

source.description: Source location within the marketplace repo. `#[serde(default)] Option<IndexSource>`, hand-written `Deserialize` accepting a string shorthand or an object.

keywords.description: Matcher keywords used to associate the plugin with a user request. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>`.

domains.description: Matcher domains used to associate the plugin with a user request. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>`.

name.description: Author display name. Required field on `IndexAuthor`.

indexSource.description: Source location in an index entry. Hand-written `Deserialize` (not derived) accepting either a plain string shorthand (a local relative path, e.g. "./plugins/foo") OR an object keyed by `type` (local sources, e.g. `{"type": "local", "path": "./plugins/foo"}`) or by the superpowers-style discriminator `source` (e.g. `{"source": "url", "url": "https://...", "ref": "main"}` or `{"source": "url", "url": "https://...", "sha": "61f19..."}`). Every object field is independently optional — the visitor tolerates any subset being absent.

oneOf.description: String shorthand: interpreted as a local relative path; normalized to `{type: "local", path: <string>}`.
Object form. No fields are required by the hand-written visitor — all keys are independently optional and default to `None` when absent.

source.description: Superpowers-format discriminator alias for `type`, e.g. "url". Adopted as `type` when `type` itself is absent.

path.description: Local path relative to the marketplace root (for local sources), or a subdirectory within a remote repo (for URL sources).

url.description: Remote git URL (used by superpowers-style marketplaces).

ref.description: Git ref (branch/tag/commit) for URL sources. Maps to `git_ref`.

sha.description: Full pinned commit SHA for URL sources (recommended for vendor pins). Maps to `git_sha`.
